title: Board Program Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Director of Board of Visitors Operations and to the Associate Secretary of the Board, the Board Program Coordinator will provide assistance and coordination of three Board stakeholder initiatives: the Board of Visitors Program; the Alumni Leadership Academy; and TCIAC, an advisory group that supports the identification of candidates for volunteer opportunities across the University. The Coordinator will also serve as a member of the team of the Office of the Secretary and will be expected to assist as necessary at all in person and virtual Board of Trustees meetings and events.

Nature And Scope

Provide support for the Board of Visitors (BOV) Program, which consists of 14 Boards of Visitors, one for each of Howard University’s Schools and Colleges. Under the direction of the Director of BOV Operations, the Coordinator will support and manage assigned administrative and operational activities related to the oversight of the Board of Visitors Program.

Supervisory Accountability

N/A

Principal Accountabilities

Board of Visions Program

This includes tracking and monitoring candidates and members through the membership cycle. The Coordinator will support the maintenance and ongoing updates of BOV operational documents, templates, trackers, and reporting tools. The Coordinator will support the Director on BOV meetings and assist in planning the Biennial Congress of the Board of Visitors Program. As relates to the BOV Program, the Coordinator will report to and work with the Director of BOV Operations.

Alumni Leadership Academy (ALA) and TCIAC

The Coordinator provides comprehensive support for the Alumni Leadership Academy (“the Academy”), which is designed to facilitate meaningful engagement between Board of Trustee members and the alumni community. Under the direction of the Associate Secretary, the Coordinator will work with select members of the Governance Committee and colleagues in Development and Alumni Relations (DAR); the Coordinator will schedule, plan, and execute virtual and in-person Academy sessions and engagement opportunities. Responsibilities include coordinating logistics; assisting with the identification, scheduling, and management of speakers and facilitators; ensuring timely communications; and serving as the principal point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. The Coordinator will attend meetings, as required. The Coordinator will manage and staff the Academy’s annual application and selection cycle, including scheduling selection committee meetings, tracking applicant and cohort data, maintaining program records and keeping Academy communications and website content current. For the Trustee Candidate Identification Advisory Council (TCIAC), the Coordinator will provide broad support for TCIAC, which acts in an advisory role to the Governance Committee of the Board to assist in broadening the pool of potential candidates considered by the Committee, and engaging the Howard University community in identifying potential candidates for various volunteer roles. Working with select member(s) of the Governance Committee of the Board of Trustees, the Coordinator will attend all meetings of TCIAC, keep records, and track proposed candidates for volunteer roles at the University, including candidates for BOV membership and for trusteeship. As relates to the Alumni Leadership Academy and TCIAC, the Board Program Coordinator will report to the Associate Secretary.

Core Competencies

  • As a member of the OS team, the Coordinator will provide additional support as requested, including for any additional community engagement initiatives emanating from the Board. The Coordinator will participate in providing staff support for all regular and special meetings of the Board.
  • Strong programmatic experience. Organized, detail oriented, and able to take direction, follow through on instructions, and prioritize tasks based on organizational priorities and urgencies.
  • Solid writing skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a high degree of discretion, confidentiality and judgment.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe, and document management.
  • Able to work effectively under time-pressure, shifting priorities or Board-driven deadlines.

Minimum Requirements

Project Management experience preferred. Must be strongly team oriented. Bachelor’s degree required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $80,000 - $85,000

description:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

The What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.

title: Back-end Developer
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Paths to Work on the Project

  • Streaming & High-Throughput Data
    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
    • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.
  • GenAI & Autonomous Agents
    • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Graph & Knowledge Engineering
    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
    • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Responsibilities

  • Job Duties: We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

  • Technical Orchestration: Drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. Decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. Review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces connectivity issues between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You Do Not Need To Be An Expert In Every Single Tool, But You Must Be Able To Discuss Technical Trade-offs Across The Entire Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

description:
TECNICO SEGURANCA DO TRABALHO

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

The domain of safety is managed and developed on the site:

  • The external and internal requirements of the domain are identified (regulatory watch and prescriptions). Based on gap analyses, action plans are proposed. The guarantee of the site's compliance with internal regulations and requirements is controlled.
  • The site has relevant and exhaustive risk analyses and action plans are defined.
  • In the context of design projects, the purchase of new machines, technical transformations of equipment or organizational changes in jobs, the position of the site safety specialist is defined and transmitted to the project team in the form of an “Avis EP”.
  • The current operating anomalies in the domain are analysed and taken into account. The necessary alerts are transmitted.
  • Good practices are shared within the site and across the country. The site safety specialist participates in or leads the business meetings of his network.
  • The annual review of the domain is presented by the site safety specialist during the EP Management Sytem Review of the site.
  • The safety specialist is the leader in his domain in terms of team support, management system and site events: steering committees, bib events, training.
  • External and internal partners are identified, and the safety specialist is the site's referent in these networks.
  • Technical support in the domain will be provided in the event of an audit (EP Management system or other audit/inspection) and in the event of a crisis impacting the area.
  • If necessary, specific projects in the field will be conducted in the form of transversal management (T-shape for example).
  • Where possible, participation in audits of other sites or even the conduct of audits will be entrusted to the site's safety specialist.
  • Where possible, the coordination of the domain at the country level will be carried out by the site safety specialist, under the guidance of the time zone.

title: Senior Director, Defect Management
description:
THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Director to Lead our Defect Management Team specializing in Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Management and resolution of defects, to join our cybersecurity team.

Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), you will play a crucial role in identifying, evaluating, and mitigating security risks associated with vulnerabilities and defects throughout the LNE organization. You will lead a team of multidisciplinary professionals and work closely with cross-functional teams across geographical regions to ensure that vulnerabilities are effectively prioritized, remediated, and monitored, thereby protecting the organization’s assets and sensitive data. As a part of this role, the candidate will be required to clearly and effectively communicate the business impact and urgency of security defects, while closely following the defined risk management process.

This position is also responsible for defining the expected outcomes of and reporting metrics for Defect Management across the Live Nation Entertainment enterprise, ensuring high quality configuration and defect remediation.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Develop, lead, and manage a high-performing security team of multiple skill sets across multiple locations
  • Enhance the Defect Management Framework, ensuring Compliance, Regulatory, and best practices is at its core
  • Cultivate the strategic direction, training, and evolution of the team to remain highly effective at various aspects of Cyber Security engagement
  • Proactively research and communicate emerging security threats through technical knowledge of the environments we operate in
  • Conduct hands-on technical security awareness training for software architects and development groups.
  • Foster effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
  • Empower the team, lead by example, and mentor all levels of competency
  • Champion improvements to internal programs and processes
  • Engage in threat modelling, security design reviews, infrastructure penetration testing, and security issue remediation verification
  • Work with application teams’ enterprise-wide to detect, prioritize, and remediate security defects throughout the SDLC process. The goal is to inject a security mindset throughout the full SDLC from concept to testing and implementation.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience working in a technical security position, penetration testing, information security hardening technologies and techniques or similar background
  • 5+ years of experience in Cyber Security related domains, with knowledge of security fundamentals, application vulnerabilities, attack vectors, penetration testing methodologies, and tools
  • 5+ years of experience driving Information Security initiatives across large diverse organizations
  • 5+ years of experience communicating with a wide range of technical & non-technical partners and senior leadership
  • Proficiency working with recognized IT Security-related standards and technologies
  • Training in Information Security-specific disciplines
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills
  • Knowledge of information security standards, rules, and regulations related to information security and data confidentiality, and desktop, server, application, database, and network security principles for risk identification and analysis
  • Experience with performing all elements of penetration testing and system exploitation against applications, APIs, Web, Mobile, and Modern Infrastructure (Containers, Microservices, Serverless etc.)
  • Experience with conducting penetration and malicious user testing in Cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and on-premises systems
  • Track record of building and growing talent with experience building and effectively managing large and diverse teams, and putting the appropriate processes and infrastructure in place to drive growth within a successful company
  • Ability to identify, attract, hire, develop, and retain the best security professionals needed to staff a world class organization and ensure they have the vision, plan, support, and culture in place to deliver impact.
  • Ethical character with ability to keep information confidential
  • Technical knowledge of adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs)
  • Understanding of common software security issues and remediation techniques (CISA KEV, OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, MITRE, etc.)
  • Domain expert on the threat landscape and innovative security strategies and products
  • Ability to work in large global environments spanning multiple time zones

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

What You'll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI.

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io).

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: Write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: Understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • Take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. title: Técnico de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
GUARACAMP!
Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.
Fazemos o que tem que ser feito, sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.
Transparência é Lei: jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.
Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.
E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos: valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.
A Guaracamp disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Atividades

  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, de acordo com as ordens de serviço.
  • Desmontar, diagnosticar falhas, reparar defeitos, substituir peças, lubrificar e remontar componentes, garantindo a eficiência operacional.
  • Realizar testes e ensaios em equipamentos após manutenção, assegurando a conformidade com as especificações técnicas e liberando para uso.
  • Interpretar desenhos e esquemas mecânicos para identificar falhas e orientar as atividades de manutenção.
  • Planejar e organizar as atividades de manutenção, incluindo a preparação de ferramentas, materiais e procedimentos necessários.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos de manutenção e sugerir melhorias em máquinas e sistemas.
  • Monitorar e manter os níveis adequados de óleo em sistemas hidráulicos e realizar ajustes conforme especificações do fabricante.
  • Garantir a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução das atividades.
  • Aplicar técnicas de segurança e cumprir normas ambientais durante todas as etapas da manutenção.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e realizar plantões.
  • Supervisionar processos de manutenção e acompanhar profissionais terceirizados, prestando suporte e orientação.
  • Participar da montagem e instalação de novos equipamentos, seguindo instruções do fabricante e orientações superiores.
  • Fornecer feedback detalhado sobre os serviços realizados e registrar informações no sistema de manutenção.
  • Reportar ao superior qualquer necessidade de substituição ou reparo que exija assistência técnica especializada.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Manutenção Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na função de manutenção mecânica em ambiente industrial.
  • Vivência em manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de máquinas e equipamentos industriais.
  • Experiência na utilização de ferramentas manuais e equipamentos de medição e diagnóstico.
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office Excel, Word e Outlook a nível de usuário.
  • Curso de NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura) atualizado (desejável).
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos e diagramas pneumáticos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turno.

title: Gerente de Operações Logísticas (Niterói)
description:
Estamos procurando um Gerente de Operações Logísticas para integrar nossa equipe! Se você é organizado, proativo e apaixonado por logística, essa é a sua chance.

O Gerente de Operações será responsável por liderar e garantir a excelência operacional em múltiplas operações logísticas para um cliente estratégico de grande porte. Esse profissional assegurará elevados padrões de segurança para os colaboradores, bem como o desempenho financeiro, operacional e humano das operações, atuando como principal elo entre a empresa e o cliente, promovendo a melhoria contínua e mantendo altos níveis de serviço.

Como criar impacto

  • Gerenciar integralmente as operações logísticas sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando o cumprimento dos SLAs acordados com o cliente e dos padrões de excelência em segurança
  • Garantir o desempenho financeiro das operações, com foco em rentabilidade, controle de custos e eficiência
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo o desenvolvimento de talentos e uma cultura de alta performance
  • Atuar como principal ponto de comunicação com o cliente, reportando resultados, planos de ação e oportunidades de melhoria
  • Desenvolver e implementar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, inovação e otimização de processos
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões estratégicas com o cliente, representando a empresa com uma abordagem consultiva e orientada a resultados

O que nós gostaríamos que tu trouxesse

  • Superior completo em Logística, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de operações logísticas de grande porte (centros de distribuição, armazenagem)
  • Vivência comprovada na gestão de SLAs e relacionamento com clientes estratégicos
  • Forte experiência em gestão financeira, incluindo controle de custos, rentabilidade e orçamento
  • Inglês intermediário- Avançado

O que há para ti

Na Kuehne+Nagel, você sempre faz parte de uma equipe comprometida e dinâmica porque grandes conquistas só são possíveis em conjunto. Oferecemos a você reais perspectivas profissionais e pessoais em um ambiente de trabalho com futuro garantido. Nossos colaboradores valorizam o alto grau de autonomia, a perspectiva de crescimento e a oferta regular de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento. O sucesso vem com as pessoas que o tornam possível, e é por isso que fazemos o nosso melhor para ter você conosco a longo prazo. Venha fazer parte deste time!

Quem somos

A logística molda o dia a dia – dos bens que consumimos aos cuidados de saúde dos quais dependemos. Na Kuehne+Nagel, seu trabalho vai além da logística; ele possibilita momentos comuns e especiais na vida de pessoas ao redor do mundo.

Como líder global com uma sólida herança e uma visão para impulsionar o mundo, oferecemos um ambiente seguro e estável onde sua carreira pode fazer a diferença. Seja ajudando a entregar medicamentos que salvam vidas, desenvolvendo soluções de transporte sustentáveis ou apoiando nossas comunidades locais, sua carreira contribuirá para mais do que você pode imaginar.

title: Assistente de RH (R&S) – Patrimar Engenharia – Barra da Tijuca
description:
Missão do Cargo

– Prestar suporte operacional e administrativo a todas as etapas do processo de Recrutamento e Seleção (R&S) focado na atração de grande escala, avaliação e contratação de profissionais da área comercial imobiliária, incluindo corretores, gerentes e gerentes gerais de vendas. O objetivo é garantir a captação de talentos qualificados e alinhados à cultura da empresa, assegurando o pipeline de candidatos para atender às demandas de crescimento da área de vendas.

ATIVIDADES

  • Divulgação de Vagas: Criar e publicar descrições de vagas em diversas plataformas (portais de emprego, redes sociais, sites especializados em imóveis, etc.) para atrair candidatos.
  • Triagem e Análise de Currículos: Realizar a triagem inicial de currículos, identificando candidatos que atendam aos requisitos básicos das posições comerciais (experiência em vendas, CRECI ativo, etc.).
  • Agendamento e Condução de Entrevistas: Agendar entrevistas e, em alguns casos, conduzir entrevistas iniciais de triagem ou dinâmicas de grupo (juntamente com os gestores).
  • Gestão do Processo Seletivo: Manter o controle do funil de recrutamento, fornecer feedback aos candidatos (selecionados e não selecionados) e garantir uma experiência positiva para o candidato (candidate experience).
  • Integração (Onboarding): Apoiar no processo de integração de novos contratados, preparando a documentação necessária e garantindo uma transição suave para as equipes de vendas.
  • Documentação e Arquivo: Organizar e manter registros atualizados dos processos seletivos e da documentação dos colaboradores.

description:
Job Description Summary

Suporte em interações entre sistemas de teste e integração de dados. Este profissional desenvolverá expertise em sistemas de test cell, com foco em rotinas de conectividade de sistemas, automação de fluxos de dados, integração de redes e suporte a aplicações de test cell. O objetivo é acelerar a resolução de falhas, padronizar interfaces entre equipamentos e sistemas corporativos e otimizar a alocação de recursos para diferentes cenários de clientes, requisitos de produto e complexidade de volume. Atuação em todos os três test cells da Celma.

Papéis e Responsabilidades

  • Suporte técnico ao time operacional e de engenharia nos processos de teste de motores, com ênfase em conectividade de sistemas (rede, protocolos e APIs), integrações entre bancos de dados e aplicativos de teste, e automação de rotinas.
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar a comunicação entre instrumentos, PSMs, PLCs, etc. Garantindo integridade, latência adequada e segurança dos dados.
  • Desenvolver e manter scripts/rotinas de coleta, transformação e carga para dados de teste, além de contribuir com dashboards e consultas para análise de performance, KPIs e rastreabilidade.
  • Apoiar a tradução de requisitos técnicos de clientes/OEM para especificações de sistemas e instruções de serviço digitais, assegurando conformidade com manuais e requisitos aplicáveis.
  • Criar e revisar instruções de serviço e padrões operacionais que incluam fluxos de dados, topologias de rede e pontos de integração com sistemas corporativos (por exemplo, SAP, Jupiter).
  • Investigar falhas de teste e anomalias de comunicação (rede, drivers, timeouts, perda de pacotes), conduzindo análises de causa raiz e implementando ações corretivas/preventivas.
  • Desenvolver ferramentas e processos para ganho de produtividade, redução de custo e melhoria da qualidade, incluindo automação de tarefas repetitivas e padronização de interfaces.
  • Administrar permissões de acesso a sistemas de teste e repositórios de dados em alinhamento com políticas de segurança cibernética.
  • Avaliar mudanças de requisitos de manuais do fabricante e/ou especificações de clientes e atuar com a engenharia na implementação em sistemas e documentação.
  • Contribuir para o sistema de garantia da qualidade por meio da revisão de registros de não conformidade, análise de tendências e implementação de correções/prevenções.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em diferentes turnos conforme demandas de produção e projetos.

Qualificações Requeridas

  • Experiência em manutenção e/ou teste de motores aeronáuticos ou ambientes industriais com integração de sistemas de teste.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de redes industriais e de TI (endereçamento IP, VLANs, segmentação, protocolos industriais e de dados).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e automação por meio de programação/scripting
  • Conhecimento prático de comunicação entre dispositivos e sistemas (por exemplo, drivers de instrumentos, APIs REST).
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação oral e escrita.

Características Desejadas

  • Habilidades de comunicação em português e inglês, com capacidade de documentar instruções técnicas claras e reprodutíveis.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e consultas para análise de dados de teste (por exemplo, SQL) e visualização de KPIs.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas industriais e de teste
  • Conhecimentos de boas práticas de segurança cibernética em ambientes industriais (controle de acesso, hardening básico, segregação de rede).
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma independente, gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e entregar resultados em ambientes de alta pressão produtiva.
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e melhoria contínua, com histórico de implementação de soluções mensuráveis.

Observações

  • Atuação presencial nos test cells, com interface constante com operações, qualidade, TI/OT e engenharia.
  • Apoio crítico à melhoria contínua do sistema de qualidade por meio de dados, conectividade confiável e padronização de processos.

Additional Information

O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Developing a strong culture of customer service is vital to the success of Development and Alumni Relations (DAR). This position assists with planning, tracking, and implementing projects that span multiple functional areas—such as Alumni Relations, Donor Relations & Stewardship, Advancement Services, Annual Giving, and University Events & Protocol. This position supports and works closely with DAR’s Associate Vice President for Development Strategy and Operations and the Vice President of Development.

N/A

The Executive Assistant facilitates the daily activities of the Associate Vice President and Vice President.   • This role manages busy executive calendars. Responsibilities include serving as the first point of contact for AVP and VP to coordinate DS&O project requests, helping route assignments to appropriate staff or teams.

Additional responsibilities include initiating efforts to ensure donor documentation is submitted in a timely manner and providing a final review to documents being submitted by the AVPs for signature of the Chief Development Officer.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated success managing and planning for multiple complex schedules and work streams;
  • Ability to provide administrative support, manage up and anticipate the needs of a senior executive;

description:
Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Desempenhar as atividades técnicas de enfermagem, prestando assistência ao paciente de forma a zelar pelo seu conforto e bem estar, realizando registros e relatórios técnicos, bem como organizando o ambiente de trabalho em conformidade às boas práticas, normas e procedimentos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico de Enfermagem Completos;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho de Classe;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 6 (seis) meses, na função proposta.

Additional information

Local de trabalho: AP 1.0 (Região Central do Rio e Paquetá)

Horário de trabalho: 40h semanais

title: Técnico de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
Overview

VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Atividades

  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, de acordo com as ordens de serviço.
  • Desmontar, diagnosticar falhas, reparar defeitos, substituir peças, lubrificar e remontar componentes, garantizando a eficiência operacional.
  • Realizar testes e ensaios em equipamentos após manutenção, assegurando a conformidade com as especificações técnicas e liberando para uso.
  • Interpretar desenhos e esquemas mecânicos para identificar falhas e orientar as atividades de manutenção.
  • Planejar e organizar as atividades de manutenção, incluindo a preparação de ferramentas, materiais e procedimentos necessários.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos de manutenção e sugerir melhorias em máquinas e sistemas.
  • Monitorar e manter os níveis adequados de óleo em sistemas hidráulicos e realizar ajustes conforme especificações do fabricante.
  • Garantir a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução das atividades.
  • Aplicar técnicas de segurança e cumprir normas ambientais durante todas as etapas da manutenção.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e realizar plantões
  • Supervisionar processos de manutenção e acompanhar profissionais terceirizados, prestando suporte e orientação.
  • Participar da montagem e instalação de novos equipamentos, seguindo instruções do fabricante e orientações superiores.
  • Fornecer feedback detalhado sobre os serviços realizados e registrar informações no sistema de manutenção.
  • Reportar ao superior qualquer necessidade de substituição ou reparo que exija assistência técnica especializada.

Requisitos

  1. Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Manutenção Industrial ou áreas correlatas
  2. Experiência mínima de 2 anos na função de manutenção mecânica em ambiente industrial
  3. Vivência em manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de máquinas e equipamentos industriais
  4. Experiência na utilização de ferramentas manuais e equipamentos de medição e diagnóstico
  5. Conhecimento básico do pacote Office Excel, word e Outlook a nível de usário.
  6. Curso de NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura) atualizado (desejável).
  7. Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos e diagramas pneumáticos
  8. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turno

Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente. Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançadono pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado. Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.⸻Responsibilities- Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:- Frontend website and marketing landing pages- Agency portal and internal tools- Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine- Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.- Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.- Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.- Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.- Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.G., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.- Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.- Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.⸻Qualifications- 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.- Experience working in a startup environment is a must.- Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.- Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.- Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.- Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.- Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.- Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.⸻Compensation- Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.- Full-time, remote role.⸻Why Join VendryJoining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Coordenador(A) De Seguranca Trabalho
description:

Singulares e plurais. Responsável pela coordenação e suporte técnico local nas áreas no cumprimento e manutenção do Sistema de gestão de segurança (CERTIFICACAO OHSAS 18001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, SA 8000, CERFLOR e FSC), participando efetivamente das Auditorias Internas e Externas;
Garantir a redução dos indicadores de acidentes e suas respectivas taxas de frequência;
Buscar significativa continua melhoria no processo de gerenciamento de incidentes e desvios, e na implantação dos itens reportados;
Melhorar os indicadoresde Auditoria Comportamental focando a mudança da cultura em segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, buscando continuamente melhoria nas rotinas observadas;
Maximizar a elevação dos níveis de maturidade prevencionista todos os níveis da empresa de acordo com as melhores práticas mercado;
Conhecer e praticar os procedimento e normas do SIG;
Ser o exemplo de comportamento seguro, incentivando a equipe a praticar um cuidado ativo e responsável;
Promover o cumprimento rigoroso dos procedimentos de segurança e a integração da prevenção na rotina;
Estimular o usoadequadodos EPIs e o exercício do direito de recusa em situações de risco grave, fomentando a proposição de soluções para o controle;
Garantir a comunicação eficaz de incidentes e a implementação das ações corretivas necessárias.QUEM NOS INSPIRA?Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
Com iniciativa;

Que proponha ideias e soluções.O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?Formação em Engenharia de Segurança;
Sólida experiencia em segurança na industrial - Segmento de papel e celulose e/ou grau de riscos 3 ou 4;

Experiencia em conduçãode ações voltadas a comportamento e cultura;
Perfil data driven;

VR ou Refeitório,VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

title: Front-End Engineering Technical Lead - (Fintech & Payments | Crypto) - Gowd
description:
Role OverviewOur client is looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to take ownership of their web platform and help define the next generation of user experience across the entire product catalog. This is a lead role for a self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building beautifully engineered products, and knows how to translate AI and computer vision outputs into compelling visual experiences.In this role, you’ll work directly with the Head of Product, the Design team, and Engineering teams to improve and expand the existing Inspection Platform, while leading front-end development for upcoming features across the broader product suite. You’ll collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, bring your own ideas to the table, and be expected to leverage modern AI coding tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development, productivity, and testing.You’ll also play a key role in shaping the user experience and human-centered design efforts as the platform evolves. This includes working closely with customers to gather feedback, validate workflows, and continuously improve usability across the product. Strong experience collaborating deeply with designers is essential.As the front-end owner across the company, you’ll be responsible for defining and maintaining front-end frameworks, tooling, and workflows, establishing best practices, and organizing a reusable, well-documented component library. Your work will enable other front-end engineers to efficiently leverage existing patterns and components as the team grows. This is an ideal role for someone who wants to be the go-to front-end leader at a growing AI startup.Key Responsibilities:Own the front-end development and evolution of our client’s product suiteLead front-end UI development and ensure consistency across multiple productsTranslate AI and computer vision outputs (segmentation masks, bounding boxes, JSON metadata) into rich, high-performance web visualizationsBuild, maintain, and document a component library using ShadCN, Radix UI, Tailwind, and Storybook in collaboration with visual designersCollaborate daily with backend engineers and designers to ensure usability, scalability, and design consistencyWork closely with backend and ML teams to integrate APIs, model outputs, and data pipelines into the front-end experienceBring creative ideas to improve UX and developer experience, from prototyping new views to optimizing rendering performanceLeverage AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to increase velocity, improve test coverage, and enhance code qualityParticipate in roadmap planning, scoping sessions, and internal reviews as the front-end leadPartner closely with the Design team to apply human-centered design principles and ensure workflows are intuitive and grounded in real customer needsParticipate in and help run customer-facing UAT sessions alongside design and product teamsTranslate customer feedback and usability findings into concrete front-end improvements and iterative design enhancementsSupport visual design execution when appropriate, ensuring high-quality UI implementation aligned with product and brand standardsMinimum Qualifications7+ years of front-end development experience;
2+ years in a senior orlead role preferredDeep expertise in React (Next.Js) and TypeScriptProven ability to integrate and visualize AI/ML outputs (JSON metadata, segmentation, bounding boxes, etc.) in scalable web interfacesExperience solving Google Maps–style visualization challenges, including zoom logic and dynamic repositioning of text, icons, and overlaysStrong experience with Tailwind, Radix UI, ShadCN, and StorybookExcellent collaboration skills and comfort working directly with product and design teamsAbility to work autonomously in a fast-paced startup environmentStrong understanding of human-centered design principlesExcellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional teams and customersPreferred QualificationsExperience with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS (ESRI)Background in computer vision or AI-powered SaaS productsFamiliarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and backend API integrationActive use of AI development tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)Experience defining or contributing to design systemsPassion for building products with real-world impact (climate resilience, infrastructure safety, etc.)Hands-on experience with UX research, usability testing, or customer researchVisual design experience or strong UI sensibility (not required, but a big plus)EducationBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field requiredA Master’s degree is preferred but not required;
equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio of shipped products are equally valuedWork EnvironmentOur client is a remote-first company, with a primary base in Los Angeles, CA. They support flexible remote work, allowing team members to work from wherever they are most productive. At the same time, they value in-person connection and host multiple all-hands offsite meetings each year to foster collaboration and team cohesion. The environment balances remote flexibility with in-person moments that matter, supporting a connected and high-performing global team.

Por que vir para a TOTVS?


Trabalhar aqui é viver em um ecossistema de aprendizado constante. Somos um universo de possibilidades :

Oportunidade de carreira em uma das marcas mais valiosas do país. Ambiente que valoriza a autonomia e a inovação. Possibilidade de atuar com um portfólio de soluções líder de mercado.

Informar e garantir a participação dos seus clientes/prospects em eventos/treinamentos;  Orientar Executivos mais juniores em visitas a clientes e/ou prospects, dominando e repassando conhecimentos sobre abordagens comerciais e formas de atuação de acordo com o perfil/segmento do cliente/prospect;  Estar atualizado com as tendências do segmento de atuação, buscando novos modelos de negócios pautados em tecnologia;  Desenvolver abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções cross voltadas aos segmentos de atuação que propiciem a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

description:
Join to apply for the Vessel Medic role at McDermott International, Ltd

Join to apply for the Vessel Medic role at McDermott International, Ltd

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

Job Description

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy’s future, and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform initial diagnoses and treatments, stabilizing patients until they can be transferred to medical facilities on land, if necessary
  • Implement disease prevention and health promotion programs
  • Monitor and control outbreaks of infectious diseases on board
  • Manage the stock of medicines and medical equipment, ensuring that they are always available and in good condition
  • Keep detailed records of all care and procedures performed
  • Train staff on first aid procedures and use of emergency equipment
  • Conduct educational sessions on occupational health and safety
  • Work with safety engineers, occupational safety technicians and other professionals to ensure a safe work environment
  • Participate in occupational health and safety meetings
  • Ensure that all medical activities comply with regulatory standards, such as NR-30 and NR-37
  • Provide ongoing guidance and training to the Nurse on medical and emergency procedures
  • In emergency situations, the Doctor makes critical decisions and guides the Nurse in carrying out the necessary procedures

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Doctor Degree in Medicine and registration with the Regional Medical Council (CRM).
  • Certifications in advanced life support, such as Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS)
  • Advanced English CBSP and HUET NR 32 and NR 37
  • Minimum experience of 02 years in Emergency Medicine or Intensive Care

Preferred Qualifications and Education:

  • Desirable offshore experience

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

A NIP do Brasil é referência em engenharia consultiva, inspeção e manutenção de redes de distribuição, atuando com excelência, segurança e inovação. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência comprovada na prestação de serviços para a Enel, com atuação em imobilização de ativos e encerramento de obras de rede elétrica (AT, MT, BT, Emergenciais e Comerciais).

  • Realizar análise de relatórios e bases de dados para obras de MT, BT, AT, E1 e Comercial.
  • Elaborar e revisar planilhas de encerramento e imobilização de ativos.
  • Garantir a conformidade regulatória em todos os processos de imobilização de ativos.
  • Alinhar com os líderes oportunidades de otimização dos fluxos de atividades e rotinas, visando ganho de eficiência.

  • Cumprir as rotinas e procedimentos para assegurar a qualidade na entrega dos serviços.
  • Representar a empresa perante clientes e parceiros, defendendo seus interesses e garantindo aderência às políticas internas, normas de compliance e princípios éticos.

  • Desenvolver talentos internos e identificar oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Realizar o repasse de oportunidades e informações estratégicas para o gerente e a diretoria.

  • Experiência comprovada em imobilização de ativos no setor elétrico.
  • Habilidade no uso do Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel.

Benefícios:

Multas: Garantir as saídas dos veículos nos horários pré-estabelecidos pelo cliente, evitando multas e No show.

Tratamento de ocorrências - demora na descarga, devolução, faltas, avarias, pedido errado, pagamento de descarga, falta de agendamento, entrega sem pedido

Normas de Segurança: Garantir o cumprimento de todas as regulamentações e normas de segurança relacionadas ao transporte da frota terceirizada, incluindo a manutenção adequada dos veículos.

Fluxo de trabalho: Gerenciar o fluxo de trabalho e priorizar as entregas de acordo com a urgência e os requisitos do cliente.

Indicador de performance: Acompanhar o indicador de performance emitido pelo cliente e monitorar o desempenho dos motoristas, fornecendo feedback e sugerindo plano de ação com foco em melhoria para garantir a eficiência e a segurança das operações.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de transporte e implementar soluções para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir os custos.

Comunicação: Colaborar com outros departamentos, como logística, operações e atendimento ao cliente, para garantir uma comunicação eficaz e a satisfação do cliente.

Situações emergenciais: Resolver quaisquer problemas ou emergências que possam surgir durante as operações de transporte, garantindo que as entregas sejam concluídas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Ensino médio completo, desejável Formação em Logística, Administração ou área relacionada.

Experiência prévia em funções similares na área de transporte, preferencialmente em empresas de logística ou transporte de carga.

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.

As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.
